product_metadata.title: EVELOTS 6 Pot Lid Organizer for Cabinet or Pantry Wall - Cupboard Door Pots and Pans Organizer - Glass or Metal Pan Covers Cabinet Organizer - Rack Hanger Dividers
features: SET of 2 KITCHEN STORAGE HACKS: Make the most of your home kitchen organization and storage. Store and select each pot top easily making food prep fast. Our pot top organizer for cabinet or wall holds up to 6 lids. Hang it on a pantry wall or install inside of the door of a cupboard or cabinet.

STURDY METAL/QUALITY CONSTRUCTION/EASY INSTALLATION: This sturdy metal pot lid rack features a smooth, rust-resistant and non-scratch plastic coating. Simply use the pan lid organizer on the inside of a cabinet or cupboard door or on a wall. Hardware included for wood cabinet door and drywall.
CUPBOARD ORGANIZERS AND STORAGE: For a flawless fit, use this lid rack caddy for pot lids with round knob or those with ear-shaped knobs no more than 2" wide. Please check your pot lid sets before.
DIMENSIONS: Pots and pans lid organizer measures 9.5 inches wide x 16.75 inches high x 3.25 inches deep.
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.
